# ReddCoin Docs

> The unified ReddCoin documentation site — protocol reference, library
> APIs, and operator guides for ReddCoin (The Social Currency).
> ReddCoin is a Bitcoin-family cryptocurrency that uses Proof-of-Stake
> Velocity (PoSV) consensus. Source code at
> https://github.com/reddcoin-project.

## Protocol & Core

- [Protocol overview](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/): Index of the protocol developer documentation.
- [Block chain](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/block_chain/): How blocks, transactions, and the chain are organised.
- [Transactions](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/transactions/): Transaction structure, scripts, P2PKH, P2SH, multisig.
- [P2P network](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/p2p_network/): Peer discovery, message protocol, mempool propagation.
- [Staking (PoSV)](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/staking/): ReddCoin's Proof-of-Stake Velocity consensus mechanism.
- [Mining](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/mining/): Historical Proof-of-Work era (blocks 0–260,799).
- [Kimoto Gravity Well](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/kimoto_gravity_well/): Difficulty retargeting algorithm walkthrough.
- [Wallets](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/wallets/): Wallet types, key management, HD wallets.
- [Payment processing](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/devguide/payment_processing/): URIs, QR codes, payment requests, refunds.

## Reference

- [JSON-RPC reference](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/reference/rpc/): Every reddcoin-cli / RPC call exposed by reddcoind.
- [Block chain reference](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/reference/block_chain/): On-disk and on-the-wire formats for blocks and headers.
- [Transactions reference](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/reference/transactions/): Transaction serialization formats, including PoSV coinstake.
- [P2P networking reference](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/reference/p2p_networking/): Wire protocol, message types, network rules.

## Examples

- [Examples index](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/examples/): End-to-end walkthroughs.
- [Transaction examples](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/examples/transactions/): Building, signing, broadcasting raw transactions.
- [Payment processing examples](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/examples/payment_processing/): Implementing the payment protocol.
- [P2P networking examples](https://docs.reddcoin.com/protocol/examples/p2p_networking/): Connecting to a peer and exchanging messages.

## Glossary

- [Glossary](https://docs.reddcoin.com/glossary/): ReddCoin and Bitcoin-family terminology with cross-references.
- [Terms](https://docs.reddcoin.com/glossary/terms/): Cross-reference targets used throughout the protocol documentation.

## Libraries

- [reddcoinjs-lib API](https://docs.reddcoin.com/api/reddcoinjs-lib/): TypeScript client library for Node.js and browsers (auto-generated from TSDoc).

## Optional

- [Brand guide](https://brand.reddcoin.com/): Brand assets, colour palette, typography.
- [GitHub organisation](https://github.com/reddcoin-project): Source code for ReddCoin Core, reddcoinjs-lib, and related projects.
